Ivy (AE): FYI Atlantic wants to migrate from VendorY's chat API to Redwood. They asked for a 10-day eval, pricing for ~1M tokens/mo, and answered an RFI. Need owners and a short plan.

Ravi (SE): I'll lead the POC. Need their sample request/response shapes and a 200-250 thread corpus. Note: VendorY returns a single envelope; we stream chunks. Likely need a proxy shim unless they change client.

Lena (Eng): Behavior note: VendorY applies reply-normalization and a deterministic top-k to reduce hallucination. We'll run semantic-similarity tests (not exact string). I'll run 250 threads and flag any similarity <0.92. Also will capture token counts.

Omar (SRE): RFI items: BYOK/KMS, SOC2 artifacts, retention windows, static egress IPs. ops-bot flagged missing SOC2 upload.

ops-bot: Auto-scan: outstanding - "SOC2 report (REQ-A1)", "BYOK/KMS flow (REQ-A2)", "IP allowlist stability (REQ-A7)". Link: /internal/security/atlantic-rfi.

Ivy (AE): Atlantic success criteria: 1) <=8% user-visible delta on critical prompts, 2) token billing variance <=3%, 3) streaming/cancel parity. They also want a zero-downtime migration playbook.

Ravi (SE): Two migration paths: (A) proxy adapter that accepts VendorY payloads and rewrites -> Redwood (fast, client unchanged), (B) migrate client to Redwood SDK (cleaner, longer). Prototype shim ETA 48-72h. Client migration ~2-3 weeks.

Lena (Eng): Eval outputs: CSV with id,vendor_tokens,redwood_tokens,cosine_sim,status and short diff snippets for low-sim cases. Will also include a human-review queue. ETA 48h after samples.

Omar (SRE): Ballpark for commercial: hosted ~ $30k/mo for 1M tokens (conservative). Dedicated reserved baseline $8k-$12k/mo depending on model and QPS. For POC we can spin temporary dedicated pool but need legal OK for interim SLA; will assemble IP egress list.

Ivy (AE): They asked for 365-day audit log retention — likely an add-on. Put that on the checklist. Also requested a sample token-reconciliation CSV for invoicing.

Ravi (SE): Shim draft example: proxy accepts VendorY chat envelope, POSTs to Redwood generate endpoint, maps streaming chunks back into VendorY envelope and returns single response to client. We'll include post-process to mimic VendorY stop-sequence and whitespace trimming.

ops-bot: Reminder queued - attach SOC2 to /internal/security/atlantic-rfi to clear REQ-A1.

Ravi (SE): Action items:
- Ivy: confirm kickoff and upload samples + NPS-like prompt set
- Lena: run 250-thread comparison, emit CSV and flagged cases (ETA 48h)
- Omar: sizing calc, IP egress block, legal intro for SLA (ETA 24h)
- Ravi: prototype proxy shim + runbook (ETA 48-72h)
- ops-bot: re-run RFI scan after uploads

Ivy (AE): I'll schedule kickoff Tue 09:00 PT and share samples once confirmed. Will negotiate retention and PO terms.

Lena (Eng): I'll post the human-review sheet and PR for the eval harness when ready.

Ravi (SE): If legal or KMS provisioning stalls, ping me and I'll escalate.

Ivy (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup:
